Those of you who work at liquor stores, what do you think of regulars?

It's like any retail job. Some you love, some you hate.

Now, it's been about twenty five years since I worked in one, but I recall we had some great regulars. There was Shady. He was a straight up bum. He would pass over his wrinkled bills to get his bottle of Mad Dog (A fortified wine by the name of MD 20/20). Smelled bad, and was on the receiving end of plenty of nasty looks, but I like him. He always had a smile, and most of the time he came in singing. Showtunes, mostly, if I recall. Another was Nancy (err...I think I'm wrong on her name). Must have been in her late eighties or older. Dressed like a church lady, always the sweetest thing. Here was what amazed me. Every day she would buy a bottle of Johnny Walker. Not the good stuff, mind you. She would be back the next day. Did she drink it alone? She was pretty sharp. Didn't strike me as an alcoholic. All I know is she would be there just as soon as we opened. Paid by check with the neatest handwriting I ever saw.

I liked some of the more informed customers. Back then, the scotch thing hadn't become popular. Price mattered for most customers more than quality. Still, there were some guys who taught me a bunch about scotch. Owe my current job to them. Never would have learned of scotch before that.

The worst were the wine customers. I've never been a wine guy, but I've never seen a bigger bunch of pretentious knuckleheads in my life.

It wasn't a great job. It's not like bartending where you get stories. It's just a retail job like any other...well, except for the handgun under the counter. That's pretty unique to liquor stores.
Perhaps Nancy was buying the bottle for an alcoholic family member? Could we agree that anyone that drinks a whole bottle of Johnny Walker everyday is an alcoholic?

I love wine, but I hate other wine drinkers.

I don't give a shit what kind of aromas or flavors there are. I just wanna get drunk, but beer takes too long, and liquor doesn't taste as good.
Good god, in college we tried Mad Dog for a drinking game and it was hands down the most foul liquor I have ever tasted. And that's saying something, because in college we drank Vald's.

The majority are pretty cool. They'll come in get what they want and head out. I've noticed the regulars are far more polite than any other customers. Always seem to go out of their way and ask me how my day is going, or if I have any plans for the weekend.
